summary: Certara, Inc. (CERT) disclosed via Form 8-K the sale of its global medical writing and related regulatory services business to Veristat, LLC. Veristat will pay $100 million in cash (subject to working capital and other adjustments) plus up to $35 million in earn-out contingent on the Business's post-close financial performance. Up to $15 million of the closing payment may be escrowed pending satisfaction of certain items. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including no material adverse effect and completion of internal reorganization steps. Watch for regulatory clearance and earn-out hurdles; risk-arb angle hinges on smooth execution of ancillary agreements.
